title: Generic path quick wins from RG review

last_report.msg: generic path: timeouts/no retries, waiting phrase line, headers, end reasons, success codes, raw placeholders

spec:
HARD DEADLINE: committed in 20 minutes (we must start the final build soon). Kit build-the-builder-v3/build-the-builder, generic service-agent path only (collection path untouched). Fix, in this priority order, stop when time is up (commit after each):
1. generate.py ~1556/1793: generic api tools timeoutMs 20000 and maxRetries 0 for ALL generic tools.
2. generate.py ~1555/1716: (covered by 1: no retries anywhere in generic path).
3. Prompt (~1855): add ONE generic line: "Before calling a service, say the rules' waiting phrase (if the rules define one) in the same message." Keep prompt growth minimal.
4. ~1801: generic tools send also "Accept: application/json"; header parameters declared in openapi and a bearer token from securitySchemes become headers with {{var}} values when a matching call variable exists (generic; skip if none).
5. ~1551 END_REASONS: derive end reasons from policy trigger actions/outcomes (normalised to [a-z_]) plus 'done' and 'no_response'; keep current set as fallback if derivation gives nothing.
6. generic_post.py:193 + inline copy: success-code list read from the openapi response schema enum/example of the result code field when available (passed via rt_post); fallback to current list.
7. generic_pre.py:55: when a {{var}} stays unfilled (literal placeholder), pass the raw text through instead of dropping the field.
No case literals (tests/test_generate.py bans some words; keep generic). Full suite: cd kit && /Users/ulas/Desktop/Freya/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" must stay green (593 OK now). Dry-run validate a generic workflow with final-mock/openapi.json (as G did) if quick. Final report ≤10 lines.
